partnershipPlan: Two patient partners who use interpreters, and two staff interpreters, review the outcome definitions and the summary for the committee.
socialListening: No social media listening; anonymised language services complaints over the last year are themed by interpreter mode.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: The video interpreter was good, but when the screen froze the doctor carried on in English.
items.implication: Report video interruptions and their effect on understanding.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I translated for my father because nobody else was there, and I did not tell him everything the doctor said.
items.implication: Treat family interpretation as a safety question in the standard.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: On a busy night I use my own Spanish because waiting twenty minutes feels worse.
items.implication: Chart evidence on tested bilingual staff and on time to interpreter.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: Everyone asks patients if they were satisfied; nobody asks if they understood.
items.implication: Keep patient-reported understanding as the primary outcome.

summary: Four composite voices on video interruptions, family interpreters, time pressure and outcome measurement.
